title: fax (development version)
text: Initial CRAN submission. effective_cores() effective_memory() return CPU cores memory process can actually use, taking cgroup v1/v2 limits, cpusets CPU affinity account. facts(), fact() facts_df() provide lazy, cached snapshot facts per-fact status source. Resolver errors never escape unless strict = TRUE. Facts describe OS (os.*), CPU, memory cgroups, process runs: bare metal VM (virtualization.*, including WSL), container (container.*), Kubernetes pod (k8s.*, including Downward API) cloud provider (cloud.provider). facts_json() writes facts JSON, optionally status source; print() facts() snapshot shows short summary process runs can use. Runtime facts describe R (version, BLAS/LAPACK, library paths, repositories credentials removed, renv, thread settings), process (pid, user, uid, privileges) Python (interpreter, version, venv/uv/conda/system, site-packages) without starting Python inside R. env.vars reports environment variables secrets redacted default (fax.redact, fax.redact_allowlist); env.proxies disk.tmpdir.* describe proxies temporary directory. usage() usage_line() report current process container CPU memory use cheaply enough call every log line.
